groups.interpretation: Exact bullish selects GREEN context/RED First; else reversed tags. Read First candle before positional bound and ordered short-circuit current/predecessor tags; no local clamping; First<=Reset or mismatch returns null.
Extend contiguous context backward from First-1 while predecessor position >=Reset and matching context; bound evaluated first.
Extend immediately preceding contiguous First-color run from context_start; same inclusive Reset bound; no disjoint runs.
Exact bullish queries inclusive local_start..First-1 min Low; reject strictly lower First Low, equality permitted; source discarded.
Bullish confirmation edge max High context_start..First inclusive; outer leg min Low Reset..First-1; independent extrema and source identities.
Create A candidate with positional First and bottom source, stored top source.index/display_time; frozen anchor and leg boundary from outer leg stored source.
Nonbullish ceiling max High local_start..First-1; reject strictly higher First High; equality permitted.
Nonbullish confirmation edge min Low context_start..First; outer ceiling max High Reset..First-1; separate sources.
Create A candidate with positional First/top source and stored bottom/anchor identities; leg and anchor value equal outer ceiling.
Iterate positional First+1 through stop inclusive; read current main; empty range falls through.
Save strict confirmation predicate before calling owner invalidation, exact bullish high>top else low<bottom.
Invoke RE94 with candidate before any edge mutation; if true return null and positional scan index, even if saved confirmation true.
Exact bullish only: strict new lower bottom mutates price plus stored candle.index and display time.
Separate exact bearish only: strict new higher top mutates price plus stored candle.index and display time; not an else branch.

If saved confirmation true, set Break to positional scan and display time, invoke refine, discard refine return, return candidate,null. Earlier mutations are not transactionally rolled back on failure.
Exhaustion returns null,null; distinct from invalidation tuple.
Read frozen leg boundary; null returns false without main price comparison; signature/docstring supply scope not extra admission.
Compute both main predicates before subsequent checks, exact bullish Low<boundary and High>top, otherwise High>boundary and Low<bottom; strict only.
No outward breach => false even if confirmed; breach without confirmation => true without lower query.
For both strict predicates, calculate main timestamp plus timeframe and traverse seconds_between full main window, not intrabar_start.
Bullish lower row: outward Low<boundary checked before High>top confirmation; immediate true/false respectively; same physical row favors invalidation.
Else lower High>boundary before Low<bottom; same-row invalidation priority; no comparison of event timestamps.
No resolving lower row, including empty window, defaults true, not unresolved or main confirmation.
Construct DetectionResult for output_direction with actual reaction/reset list references and start/end window; no clone/sort, lookup failures propagate.
Public keyword-only optional stop gate passed to _detect with retain_cursor=False; no local continuation state publication.
